resources.string: High touch polling rate, single tap to wake
Raise the touch sampling rate for faster response, at the cost of battery life
Tap the screen once to wake the device while the screen is off
Manage eSIM support for the device
Use eSIM to connect to mobile networks without a physical SIM card. Enabling eSIM switches SIM slot 2 from the physical card tray to the internal eSIM chip.
Switch SIM slot 2 to use eSIM instead of the physical nano-SIM card
No switchable eSIM slot is available on this device
Turn off your active eSIM profile in SIM settings before switching back to the physical SIM card.
Unlock 10–120 Hz range and switch dimming from DC to PWM

Unlocks LTPO adaptive refresh rate scaling down to 10 Hz when idle and 1 Hz on Always-On Display, and switches display dimming from DC to PWM.\n\nTurning this off restores DC dimming and the standard 60–120 Hz range.
Match exact 24, 30, or 60 Hz during video playback; when off, cap ≤30 Hz playback at 30 Hz and ≤60 Hz at 60 Hz
LTPO adaptive refresh rate is not supported on this display
